_comment: Countries shown as pins on the world map (reizen.html). 'iso' is a plain ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (NL, BE, US, ...) , the same standard everyone uses, so it's never ambiguous and never needs 'figuring out'. That code is looked up directly in assets/data/world-map.json (pin position, auto-computed from real geography) and assets/data/countries/<ISO>.json (that country's own high-detail outline, shown when you click its pin) , see assets/js/modules/geo-render.js. It must also match the country name used in captions.json's 3rd caption field (case-insensitive, matched against 'name' below , see assets/js/modules/reizen-land.js).
_pinComment: 'pin' is OPTIONAL, by default a country's pin sits at the geographic centroid of its mainland (computed automatically, see STAPPENPLAN-REIZEN.md's data-pipeline notes). Set 'pin' to override that with a specific {lon, lat} instead , e.g. a capital city, easy to look up on Wikipedia/Google Maps, no pixel-guessing involved. Longitude first, then latitude (same order as GeoJSON).
_visitedCityPinsComment: 'visitedCityPins' is OPTIONAL per country , a map of city name (must match the 'Plaats' used in captions.json, case-insensitive) to its real-world {lon, lat}. Look the coordinates up once (Wikipedia's infobox, or right-click 'What's here' on Google Maps) and they'll always render in exactly the right spot on that country's map, at any zoom, no trial and error. Leave a city out and reizen-land.js falls back to an automatic fan-out layout for it instead; nothing breaks. Every city listed here shows up as a pin on the country page (reizen/land.html) even if it has no photos yet , clicking it just shows a 'no photos yet' hint instead of a photo grid, see reizen-land.js.
_unvisitedCityPinsComment: 'unvisitedCityPins' is OPTIONAL per country , same {lon, lat} format as 'visitedCityPins' above, for cities you'd like to visit (as opposed to 'visitedCityPins', which is for cities you've already been to / are cataloguing photos for). Rendered as a blue dot on the country map, same blue as the existing 'Op verlanglijstje' row in the legend on reizen/land.html. A city shouldn't be in both lists at once; once you've actually been, move it from here into 'visitedCityPins' instead. This file only ever supplies the PIN POSITION ({lon, lat}) , the moodboard shown when you click a wishlist pin (short caption, click-to-enlarge, longer caption with a working link) comes from captions.json instead, exactly like a real photo: give a captions.json entry a full http(s) URL as its key (instead of an R2 filename) and it's treated as a public stock/inspiration photo for that country+place, no login required to see it , see the gallery worker's own file header (cloudflare/gallery/gallery_worker.js) and cloudflare/gallery/captions.json's worked Porto example for the exact format.
